staleClaims.claim: "Solver calls IntentBondFactory.createBond(solver)" (flow diagram step 1 and 'How It Works' step 1 show the solver creating their own bond)
staleClaims.currentTruth: createBond is gated by onlyKeeper; only a keeper can deploy a SolverBond for a solver, not the solver themselves

staleClaims.claim: "Ark can cancel intent before solving via resignByUser() (only in Created state)"
staleClaims.currentTruth: resignByUser is onlyKeeper (not callable by the Ark) and also accepts the Solved state, in which case the escrowed yield is returned to the solver; only states other than Created/Solved revert

staleClaims.claim: State diagram shows only Created/Solved/Settled/UserResigned/SolverResigned with transitions Created→UserResigned and Solved→SolverResigned
staleClaims.currentTruth: The IntentState enum also contains None and Active; resignBySolver is accepted from both Solved and Active states, and resignByUser is accepted from Solved as well as Created (Solved→UserResigned missing from diagram)

staleClaims.claim: Solving only requires a bond: 'Solver sees intent and calls solveIntent... directly' with bond verification as the only gate
staleClaims.currentTruth: solveIntent is additionally gated by onlySolver, which requires the keeper to have pre-registered an escrow for the solver via addSolverEscrow (onlyKeeper); it also enforces an oracle staleness check (MAX_PRICE_AGE = 1 hour) never mentioned in the doc

unverifiable: Off-chain steps: 'Ark posts intent offchain' and 'Keeper is obliged to deposit to solvers protocol' are process descriptions with no on-chain enforcement to check (the 10-minute BUFFER_TIME itself is confirmed at IntentHandler.sol:39)

Settlement is gated on block.timestamp >= intent.expiry, not on solve-time + term; the term field is only range-checked at creation (MIN_TERM 1 day / MAX_TERM 365 days)

summary: Audited 5 docs in group earn:intent-arks. None fully current. (1) intent-system/README.md: partially-stale — architecture, signatures, 10-min BUFFER_TIME, 50% slash and hasCommitted all confirmed, but createBond is keeper-only (doc says solver calls it), resignByUser is keeper-only and also works in Solved state (doc says Ark-only, Created-only), and the state diagram omits the Active state. (2) solver-mvp/SOLVER_README.md: partially-stale — script-facing claims (addresses, menu, gas, API) match simple_solver.py, but requirements.txt doesn't exist, the '1000 SUMMER minimum' isn't an on-chain rule, the documented Intent struct omits the contract's requiredBond field, and createBond is keeper-gated. (3) solver-mvp/README.md: obsolete — a misplaced Next.js interface README (the app lives in packages/simple-interface-app); nothing in solver-mvp matches it. (4) arks/README.md: partially-stale — hook signatures, access roles and slippage constants confirmed, but the ark classification list is missing ~20 arks, the new ArkWithSwap base invalidates the 'Ark or ArkWithWithdrawalRequest' dichotomy, and the withdrawUsingSwap 'amount encoded in data' bullets no longer match SwapData{router,swapCalldata}. (5) dutch-auction/README.md: partially-stale — structure/lifecycle/kicker/deploy claims confirmed, but decay is Linear/Quadratic (not 'exponential'), the structure tree omits DutchAuctionMath/DecayFunctions and extra tests, and the MIT license claim conflicts with BUSL-1.1 SPDX headers in src.
